Eleblorb · Moy · package P17 · proposed 2026-10-18

The BLOCK tower in 3D

Moy's one dark tower: the blue-black shaft with its three rings of vent hoods, the crown folded to a blade with its one azure slit, and a section through the story. Only three places inside are built: the plant floor behind the one open louvre, the hollow crown where the fight is, and the lobby you leave by. Everything else is solid mass that one lift passes without stopping. True size, on its plot on Meridian South, with its neighbours as plain blocks.

The way through

    loading

    The inside is its own scene, out of the city's bake, loaded only when the hero goes in. The two lift rides are where its parts load, so no loading screen shows.

    no text

    Nothing names the way up, the mech or the slime. The open louvre breathes warm, lit air at night; the lab's two benches and two mugs say who works there. The one Demon King line comes at the very end, in the moment, about Kask's reward.

    round P17a · a third playable rig, on the hero's own joints

    The blorb mech

    Built on the hero's own rig: every joint is his, scaled by , so the blorb suit fits it through the suit's existing rig scale. Thin limbs and body in one matte black metal, with bright steel only on the chest plate; shoulder pads; a neck; the hero's solid hands and feet in black steel; and the hero's head shape split into a glass visor, which hinges open at the top for a blorb to climb in, and a steel shell behind and under it. A thread of the city blorbs' own blue runs through its abdomen, joints and chest. Beside it stand the hero and Moy's door, exported from the game.

    The people of the tower

    Dr. Vera Kask and Palbert Pinestein, built in the game from their looks (moy_pkg_P17_looks.json) and exported, beside the hero. Kask's look is all in the existing kit. Pinestein needs two new shared pieces, drawn here on top and marked: a wild-hair style and a lab coat.
